say:3:1831102001:1.text: You dirty scammer! You stole our gold and tried to slip away!
say:3:1831102001:1.source_cn: 你这骗子！骗了别人的钱还想跑！

say:4:1831102002:1.text: Don't think you can hide just because your HQ collapsed! Pay up! I want my returns, every last coin!
say:4:1831102002:1.source_cn: 别以为你们商会大楼塌了，我就找不到你！快还钱！把我的利...

say:5:1831102003:1.text: Oh, give it a rest. I didn't scam you out of anything! You chose to invest, and when you redeemed your funds, I gave you your principal and whatever profits remained!
say:5:1831102003:1.source_cn: 少胡说了，我可没骗你钱！当初是你自愿投资的，你赎回资金...

say:6:1831102004:1.text: Everything was handled according to the terms of the investment contract. You signed it yourself, and there are two copies on record. You can't just deny it.
say:6:1831102004:1.source_cn: 一切都是按照投资合同上的条款来的，那合同可是你亲笔签的...

say:7:1831102005:1.text: That's nonsense! We cashed out nine days ago. By contract, our profits should've been locked in that very day!
say:7:1831102005:1.source_cn: ——胡扯！我们明明是九天前赎回的，按照合同，我的利润当...

say:8:1831102006:1.text: What right did you have to wait until after we pulled out to post some shady notice changing the asset terms, forcing us to swallow the next day's market drop?!
say:8:1831102006:1.source_cn: 你们凭什么在我们赎回之后，又发公告说什么标的变更，非让...

say:9:1831102007:1.text: Exactly! I was sitting on a 60% profit margin! Then your bogus announcement slashed it down to 20%!
say:9:1831102007:1.source_cn: 没错！我原本还有百分之六十的利润率，结果就因为你们这一...

say:10:1831102008:1.text: Pay up! Give me back the difference! That's my money!
say:10:1831102008:1.source_cn: 还钱！把相差那部分利润还给我！那是我应得的！

say:11:1831102009:1.text: When the underlying asset changes, the daily yield adjusts with it. That clause was in the contract!
say:11:1831102009:1.source_cn: 投资标的发生变更，当天的利润自然也会跟着变化，这是合同...

say:12:1831102010:1.text: If you didn't like the adjustment, you could've just canceled your withdrawal after seeing the notice.
say:12:1831102010:1.source_cn: 要是你不接受这些利润，看到公告以后完全可以撤销赎回啊。

say:13:1831102011:1.text: Cancel?! You waited until midnight to slap that notice on the board! I was already in bed, and your office was closed! How was I supposed to cancel it?!
say:13:1831102011:1.source_cn: 撤销个屁！你们一直等到新月才把公告贴到告示栏里，那时候...

say:14:1831102012:1.text: The Adamant Syndicate ought to change its name to Heartless Syndicate! Give us our money back!
say:14:1831102012:1.source_cn: 你们黑金商会真该改名叫黑心商会！快还钱！

say:15:1831102013:1.text: You're the ones who don't understand how investing works. Don't blame the Syndicate for your own ignorance!
say:15:1831102013:1.source_cn: 没这种好事！明明是你们自己缺乏投资概念，少来怪我们商会！

say:16:1831102014:1.text: If you don't like it, take it up with manager Edward!
say:16:1831102014:1.source_cn: 不服的话，就去找爱德华经理啊！

fork:200:18311030:choice:3:0:1.male: Stop doing business with the Syndicate.

fork:300:18311040:say:3:1831104001:1.text: Don't even think about denying it! Even if I have to drag you before Lady Novaris, you're paying us back today!
fork:300:18311040:say:3:1831104001:1.source_cn: 别想抵赖！就算要把你押到领主阁下面前去，今天也必须让你还钱！

fork:300:18311040:choice_prompt:4:183110.text: Don't even think about denying it! Even if I have to drag you before Lady Novaris, you're paying us back today!
fork:300:18311040:choice_prompt:4:183110.source_cn: 别想抵赖！就算要把你押到领主阁下面前去，今天也必须让你还钱！

fork:300:18311040:say:5:1831104002:1.text: A manufactured "risk" like this? Not a chance!
fork:300:18311040:say:5:1831104002:1.source_cn: 这种人为制造的“风险”，我不能接受！

fork:300:18311040:say:6:1831104004:1.text: Investments go up and down. What business in this world guarantees a profit? Not among the living, not among the dead. You're a Graveborn—you should know that better than anyone.
fork:300:18311040:say:6:1831104004:1.source_cn: 投资本来就是有赚有赔，天底下哪有稳赚不赔的生意？不管生...

fork:300:18311040:say:7:1831104005:1.text: Besides, you still walked away with a 20% cut, didn't you? At the end of the day, you made money.
fork:300:18311040:say:7:1831104005:1.source_cn: 再说了，你们现在不是还有百分之二十的收益吗？归根究底还...

fork:300:18311040:say:8:1831104006:1.text: We could've made much more if you hadn't issued that shady notice!
fork:300:18311040:say:8:1831104006:1.source_cn: 要是你们没发那份不合规的公告，我们本来能赚更多的！

fork:300:18311040:say:9:1831104007:1.text: Shady? This isn't the Lightbearer Empire. Novaris has no investment regulations. Every notice we issue is completely legal and above board.
fork:300:18311040:say:9:1831104007:1.source_cn: 不合规？这里又不是耀光帝国，诺珐斯可没有什么投资规定，...

fork:300:18311040:say:10:1831104008:1.text: My advice is to take your winnings and walk away. And even if you wanted to recover the difference, what are you going to do? Take this all the way to Bantus? Everyone knows His Lordship hates trouble.
fork:300:18311040:say:10:1831104008:1.source_cn: 我劝你们见好就收，否则就算你们想要回相差的利润，难不成...

fork:300:18311040:say:11:1831104009:1.text: ... So what if we do take it to Bantus?!
fork:300:18311040:say:11:1831104009:1.source_cn: ……就算要闹到班题斯去，那又怎么样？！

fork:300:18311040:say:15:1831104012:1.text: I'm genuinely trying to help you here. Really.
fork:300:18311040:say:15:1831104012:1.source_cn: 我的劝告是真心实意地为你们好，真的。

fork:300:18311040:say:16:1831104013:1.text: Hmph... I'll let you off the hook for today. But once relations between Novaris and Bantus stabilize, I'm coming back for every coin that belongs to me!
fork:300:18311040:say:16:1831104013:1.source_cn: 哼……今天就先放过你，等诺珐斯和班题斯之间的关系稳定下...

fork:300:18311040:say:17:1831104014:1.text: Fine by me! As long as you bother the Syndicate directly next time instead of picking on me!
fork:300:18311040:say:17:1831104014:1.source_cn: 没问题，只要你直接去找黑金商会，不找我的麻烦就行！

fork:300:18311040:say:18:1831104015:1.text: Hahaha! The Novaris branch blew up, and I've finally found a chance to get out of this dump!
fork:300:18311040:say:18:1831104015:1.source_cn: 哈哈，诺珐斯分部爆炸，我总算找到机会离开这个破地方了——！

fork:300:18311040:choice:12:0:1.text: They're allied. Bantus won't help you.
